The solution would be to ensure the data loaded from CSV is converted to float32, which can be verified by adding `A = A.astype('float32')` after loading the CSV data. This is a common issue with Faiss where input data needs to be explicitly cast to float32.

This is purely a code analysis issue that doesn't require building or running the code to verify.
